info.about: Sword of Mana, originally released in Japan as Shin'yaku: Seiken Densetsu , is a 2003 action role-playing game developed by Square Enix and Brownie Brown and published by Square Enix and Nintendo for the Game Boy Advance.
info.why: Never re-released: Collection of Mana includes the Game Boy original, not this 2003 remake, so the cartridge is the only version.
